final.role: Static word-embedding vectors and training code (not passage search)
final.evidence: implementation of the GloVe model for learning word representations; pretrained vectors under PDDL; code under Apache 2.0

auditoria.nota: Word-level static vectors from English-heavy corpora (Wikipedia, Gigaword, Common Crawl); a weak base for pt/en passage search next to modern sentence embedding models.
